violation_type.title: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Have a Communication Device (26 TAC §746.5621(1))
violation_type.short_title: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Have a Communication Device
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient when a bus driver did not have a communication device to access the daycare available during the time of transport.
